description: V0.8c prospective funding-refusal evaluation (docs/benchmark/v08c-dev/PLAN.md): no action, greedy, conservative-v2 and llm-agent 3 (agents/llm/llm_agent3.py; the V0.6c and V0.7c agent's prompt, memory and settings, with every attempt recorded) with the two frozen models, on suite dreamteam-dev version 4's financial-pressure-credit (the control) and financial-pressure-lowliquidity (the same practice with $80,000 opening cash), daily decisions at 07:00. No score, no ranking. Run from the repository root with DREAMTEAM_LLM_BASE_URL set. Two seeds, 30 days: 20 runs, 8 of them live LLM runs.
seedPlan: Chosen 2026-10-30 and committed in the V0.8c plan (docs/benchmark/v08c-dev/PLAN.md) before any run on them: the next unused block after the V0.8b probes' 41801: 41900 for the deterministic scenario analysis only (no policy, no model), 41901 and 41902 for the evaluation. None appeared in the repository before; not a reference seed (1001-1020), not a V0.2 development seed (901-910), not drawn from any reserved stream, not a benchmark holdout seed (none exists); the sealed clinical holdout guard accepts them.
